25790164_ac72f24f.text: O-LM interneurons are of great interest since they evidently provide a theta-frequency patterned output to distal dendritic segments of pyramidal cells (Gloveli et al., 2005) that receive specific sensory information (reviewed in Vinogradova (Vinogradova, 1995)) essential for the activity of place cells (Losonczy et al., 2002)

25790164_e5e2a874.text: oriens-lacunosum moleculare (O-LM) interneurons because they are known to fire intermittently at the theta frequency (Buzsáki, 2002)(Klausberger et al., 2003)
